options.Нейтральное / Спокойствие: Neutral / Calm — The base facial expression, the starting point for all other emotions.
options.Легкая улыбка / Радость: Joy / Smile — A friendly, relaxed state.
options.Простая улыбка с приоткрытым ртом: Soft Open-Mouthed Smile / Innocent Grin — The eyes are relaxed, narrowed with warmth or drawn in soft arcs. The eyebrows are slightly raised, expressing openness and friendliness. The mouth is softly open in a neat triangle or crescent shape (showing the top row of teeth or just a clean outline), with a light, natural blush on the cheeks. This emotion radiates absolute sincerity and soft innocence.
options.Хитрая ухмылка / Торжество: Smirk / Triumphant — One corner of the mouth is raised, eyes are narrowed, the character is up to something.
options.Искренний восторг / Счастье: Ecstatic / Pure Happiness — A wide smile, possibly with a slightly open mouth and eyes squinted with pleasure.
options.Смех (Хохот) — Laughing / Giggling: Laughing / Giggling — A wide-open mouth with teeth exposed and corners of the lips pulled sharply upward. The eyes are squinted or shut tight, forming crow's feet wrinkles around them. Eyebrows may be slightly raised from the burst of energy. The character's head is often tilted back or bent forward.

options.Раздражение: Annoyed / Irritated — Slightly furrowed eyebrows, pressed lips.
options.Ярость / Гнев: Rage / Angry — Strongly scowling eyebrows, a snarl or a scream, wide-open eyes.
options.Отвращение / Презрение: Disgust / Contempt — A wrinkled nose, a raised upper lip, looking down on someone.
options.Надменность / Высокомерие: Arrogance / Smugness — A looking down on viewer, half-closed arrogant eyes, tsurime eyes, arrogant expression, condescending look, haughty stare.
options.Обида / Надутость: Pouting / Sulking — Downturned corners of the mouth, looking up from under the brow.
options.Злорадство: Smug / Malicious Joy — An aggressive or sly, wicked smile.

options.Печаль / Грусть: Sad / Sorrow — Downturned corners of the mouth, the inner corners of the eyebrows are raised upward.
options.Отчаяние: Despair, wide open miserable eyes, dead eyes, empty stare, shocked expression, lost all hope, heartbreak, no tears, sad expression.
options.Плач: Crying wide open eyes welled up with tears, tears streaming down cheeks, sad expression.
options.Рыдание: Crying, eyes squeezed shut, streaming tears, sobbing, emotional breakdown.
options.Испуг: Scared / Frightened — Tense/hunched shoulders, wide-open eyes, dilated pupils.
options.Ужас / Паника: Terrified / Panic — An extreme degree of fear, the mouth is open in a silent scream, trembling.

options.Любопытство / Заинтересованность: Curious / Interested — Raised eyebrows, a slightly tilted head, a focused gaze.
options.Самоуверенность: Confident / Defiant — A raised chin, half-closed eyes, a bold/audacious look at the viewer.
options.Недоверие: Suspicious / Distrustful — One eye is slightly narrowed, eyebrows are uneven.
options.Усталость: Tired / Exhausted — Drooping eyelids, dark circles under the eyes, a half-open relaxed mouth.
options.Скука: Bored / Apathetic — The cheek is propped up by a hand, a blank stare into nowhere, a complete lack of facial tone.
options.Шок / Изумление: Shocked / Surprised — High-raised eyebrows, a rounded mouth, wide circular eyes.

options.Смущение / Стыд: Embarrassed / Flushed — Looking away, blushing cheeks, an awkward smile.
options.Виноватое смущение: Sheepish Apology / Guilty Blush — The eyebrows form an 'inverted V' (the inner corners are raised upward, showing submission), and the eyes are cast down at the floor. A light blush of shame is on the cheeks. The character smiles awkwardly with one side of their mouth, pulling their shoulders in, trying to look smaller and beg for forgiveness.
options.Врасплох: Moe Surprise / Caught Off Guard — The eyes round and widen in shock, and the pupils are dilated. The face instantly flushes red. The palms fly up to the face (the character either covers their mouth or shields themselves with their hands), and the knees comedically turn inward. A total loss of control over the situation.
options.Нервирующая игривая улыбка: Smug Tease / Playful Menace — A slight, wicked crescent-shaped smile where the corners of the lips are pulled sharply upward, but the mouth remains closed. The eyes are narrowed, and the gaze is fixed directly on the 'victim'. This emotion conveys absolute confidence and the knowledge of a secret, making everyone around break into a cold sweat.
options.Попытка скрыть стыд: Tsundere Blush / Looking Away — His face is flushed, yet the young man pointedly turns his head away. His lips are pressed tight or pursed in a pout, and his brows are furrowed. He steals a sidelong glance back at the object of his adoration.
options.Неловкий смешок: Nervous Sweatdrop — A crooked, strained smile, one eyebrow raised, and a huge bead of sweat standing out on his temple or the back of his head. His expression is pleading; the guy is trying to smooth over the awkward situation.

options.Щенячий восторг: Starburst Joy / Puppy Eyes — The eyebrows soar upward in admiration, and the mouth is stretched into a wide, happy smile. The pupils are completely replaced by bright four-pointed or multi-pointed stars. The face may be leaned slightly forward, expressing an extreme degree of adoration and anticipation.
options.Сон со слюнкой: Sleeping Soundly / Drooling Sleep — The eyes are completely closed, drawn with simple soft arcs (or horizontal U_U lines). The face is totally relaxed, and the eyebrows are on a single level. The mouth is slightly open, and a comedic drop of drool is trickling from the corner. You can draw an anime snot bubble or 'Z-z-z' letters around the character.
options.Кровь из носа: Nosebleed Shock — The eyes go perfectly round and pupil-less (the 'white screen' effect). The mouth hangs wide open in astonishment, while comical blood either drips or spurts in a fountain from the nose.
options.Перегрузка: System Overload / Dumbfounded — He freezes up when complimented or hugged. His gaze goes blank (eyes become mere dots or white circles without pupils), his mouth hangs open in an 'O'-shape, and steam or spirals could be drawn around his head.
options.Кавайное окаменение: Comedic Petrification — The guy freezes like a stone statue. His face is rendered in rough gray strokes (a stone effect), and his eyes are either squeezed shut or reduced to mere dots, expressing sheer panic at the female attention.
options.Душа покидает тело: Soul Leaving Body / Ghosting — The facial expression is completely 'wiped away', and the eyes turn into two simple dashes. After an overly close encounter with the girl, the character's pale, ghostly soul literally flies out of his mouth in the form of an incorporeal little cloud.
